description.value: Sunday Cider is a craft cidery and cider bar on a 20-acre property along the Sunshine Coast Highway near Gibsons, producing small-batch ciders from 100% fresh-pressed BC apples with no added yeast, filtration, or additives. Cyclists can settle into the outdoor picnic area with cider flights, resident food trucks (Sea Monkey Coffee and Casa Beto Tacos), and regular live music on the grass. Dogs and kids on leashes are explicitly welcome, making it a relaxed stop on the Sunshine Coast route.
